integrity: Analytic stationary heat identity and Laguerre spectral proof; a separate raw-generator stationary-moment checker ran 189 exact rational assertions. No independent verification has been performed.
limitations: The force-design class is smooth centered radial forces of polynomial growth under isotropic transverse Ornstein–Uhlenbeck confinement and linear axial relaxation with an independent matched thermal bath; it does not encode global optical-beam constraints, inertia, or finite-data estimation.
title: Quadratic radial forcing is the unique least-dissipative nonconservative optical-trap profile
